purpose: スタート画面の塔の光色とリンデ周辺の地形を修正

sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: revised landscape RPG title background, 1536x1024.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the beautiful deep blue starry sky, painterly high-detail style, warm Linde market town on the left, fields, foreground old trade path, title-space and general composition. Make these TWO specific revisions together:
1. Add THREE very distant starlight beacon towers along the receding countryside: one left distant ridge, one center valley behind the town, one far center-right. Their silhouettes are tiny and softened by atmospheric haze, with distinct small pale violet points of light. Vary distance and brightness; tallest remote tower less than one sixth the height of the main tower. Main Linde tower remains overwhelmingly the primary landmark. Remote beacons must read as faraway destinations, not a row of nearby towers.
2. Fix the hydrology/topography around the main purple tower on the right. It must no longer stand on the dry convex summit of an isolated mound. Rebuild its base as a slightly sunken stone-founded terrace on the shoulder of a broader gentle hill; a higher tree-covered slope rises immediately BEHIND AND RIGHT of the tower's base, directing rain runoff and seepage toward the tower terrace. Keep the tower lantern above the nearby treetops. Show a shallow shaded concave hollow at the rear/side foundation, damp mossy stone joints, darker moist vegetation, and a small ancient stone-lined drainage route. Most of this drain is underground or covered by flat stones: show only short visible segments and a low partly grass-concealed stone outlet farther down the slope, with a thin thread of moonlit water continuing in a narrow ditch around the field margins, bypassing crops. It should be visually plausible that obstruction of this small outlet could back water up into the tower's stonework. Show geography that COULD suffer blockage, not a currently flooded ruin. No need to show fallen tree or plot spoilers. Use subtle wet glints and stone construction readable at this scene scale; keep the drain small and subordinate to the landscape. Do NOT create a river, pond, lake, waterfall, moat, aqueduct, grand arched bridge or large open irrigation canal.
Main tower design and pale violet/lavender crown/window glow remain as reference, grey masonry, modest purple halo; domestic lamps and windows stay warm amber. Preserve everyday rural peaceful inhabited atmosphere. No snowy mountains, cliffs, gorges or island city. Upper 35% quiet starry sky and bottom 18% dark path suitable for separate UI overlays. No characters, text, logos, UI, labels, arrows, cutaway diagrams or watermark. Landscape full bleed.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: portrait 1024x1536 mobile title background for STARLIT GUILD.
Input 1: newly revised LANDSCAPE, the authoritative visual reference for terrain, drainage and all four towers.
Input 2: previous PORTRAIT, edit target for vertical framing, foreground and title-safe layout.
Recompose input 1's corrected scene into input 2's portrait composition. Keep starry deep blue night, painterly detail, old trade path in foreground, warm small market town on left, cultivated fields, and main grey stone tower on the right with pale violet/lavender windows and crown. Preserve upper 32-35% quiet sky for a separately applied logo and lower 18% subdued foreground path for START.
Required: THREE tiny faraway tower beacons, each glowing dim pale violet, spread across distant ridges and valley beyond town, at different depths, softened by haze. Keep all three inside the portrait frame. Remote tower silhouettes no more than 1/6 main tower height, preferably smaller. Main Linde tower remains dominant.
Required hydrological correction from input 1: main tower sits on a slightly sunken terrace on the SHOULDER of a hill, NOT isolated dry convex summit. Immediately behind and right of its foundation, a higher wooded slope rises, visibly able to feed rain/seepage downhill toward tower stonework. The lantern still rises above local tree line. Shaded shallow depression and damp mossy masonry at rear and side base. Old drain mostly underground beneath soil and slab stones. A small low stone drainage outlet on the slope below, partially grass concealed, releases only a thin trickle into a narrow ditch around crop-field margins. This makes it plausible that a blocked outlet would retain water around foundations. Retain the modest outlet and higher wooded slope from input 1, not a big water feature. No flood, giant stream, pond, lake, moat, dramatic waterfall, large bridge or aqueduct. No fresh fallen tree or visible blockage; this is peaceful title art.
Keep tiny amber house windows and lanterns distinct from purple tower magic. No alpine snow peaks, cliffs, gorge, island city. No people, text, logo, UI, diagram, arrows or watermark. Full bleed portrait illustration.

precedingEdits.landscape:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: revised landscape background for the STARLIT GUILD Japanese RPG start screen, landscape 1536x1024.
Input image 1: existing title background, EDIT TARGET and reference for painterly rendering, deep blue starry sky, peaceful nighttime mood and image quality.
Primary request: correct the tower light and replace the unsupported alpine-lake geography with the established rural surroundings of Linde.
Preserve the beautiful rich starry deep teal-blue night sky, hand-painted atmospheric depth, grounded inhabited fantasy, stone and moss details.
Rebuild the land composition: a modest old trade road enters from the dark foreground and leads past cultivated fields and patches of woodland toward a small lived-in market town in the middle distance. A side path leads from the town past fields and through a small grove up a gentle grassy hill on the right, where ONE old slender stone starlight tower stands. The tower is part of the nearby rural landscape, accessible by an ordinary sloping path, not on a cliff or isolated rock. One coherent countryside, soft rolling hills, only low subdued distant mountain silhouettes.
The tower's upper windows/crown emit unmistakably soft PALE VIOLET / LAVENDER light, visibly purple even at reduced size, with a restrained local lavender halo. No golden tower light, no intense laser or sky beam. House windows and ordinary roadside lanterns retain small WARM AMBER lights, clearly distinct from the magical purple tower. Tower masonry remains natural grey stone.
Remove all additional towers, the great lake, island/lake city, snowy alpine peaks, waterfalls, deep gorges, dramatic cliffs, giant arched bridges and aqueducts. No large bodies of water.
Composition: upper 35 percent is quiet starry sky for a separately overlaid title logo. Lower 18 percent is dark subdued path/grass for a separate START button. Town and single purple tower clearly readable within the middle band, tower around right-center. The scene should evoke everyday trade, nearby homes and a small adventure, while retaining cinematic beauty.
No people, no characters, no text, no logos, no interface, no border, no watermark. Full bleed landscape artwork.
precedingEdits.portrait:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: portrait 1024x1536 mobile start-screen background for STARLIT GUILD.
Input image 1: approved-direction newly corrected landscape background; EDIT TARGET, exact reference for the scene, tower design, starry sky, palette and painterly finish.
Recompose this same countryside for a vertical portrait screen, not a narrow crop. Preserve the modest market town of Linde on the left middle distance, cultivated fields, woodland patches, soft grassy hills, old foreground trade path, and exactly ONE stone tower on the gentle hill on the right. Preserve the tower's unmistakable soft PALE VIOLET/LAVENDER upper-window and crown glow, modest lavender halo, natural grey masonry, with small warm amber town windows and roadside lanterns. Purple magic and warm domestic lights must remain distinct.
Show a continuous ordinary path from the town past farmland and a grove up the gentle tower hill. Peaceful rural everyday world, atmospheric hand-painted night landscape. Preserve the beautiful deep blue starry sky and subtle Milky Way.
Composition: upper 32-35 percent quiet starry sky for a separate logo, town and tower both entirely visible in the middle, lower 18 percent subdued dark foreground path for a separate START control. Keep tower inside frame with generous margin. Town is a small market town, not a castle or metropolis.
Strict constraints: no added towers, no great lake, no island city, no snowy alpine peaks, no cliffs or gorges, no waterfalls, no monumental bridges. Low distant ridgelines only. Do not change to daytime. No people, no characters, no text, no logo, no UI, no border, no watermark. Full bleed portrait art.

settingBoundary: 既存設定に沿った背景構図。遠景3塔の所在地・名前・方角・距離は未確定。地図の地点や接続、シナリオは変更しない。
